brand_identity.name: Emporio Zeva
brand_identity.vibe: Warm, tactile, heritage, artisanal, surprising, editorial luxury food
brand_identity.core_concept: Not-A-Salami (Salame al Cioccolato). A visual surprise: looks like cured meat, tastes like rich cocoa.
taglines: Born in Sicily. Served in slices.
Slice thin. Serve slow. Share generously.
One slice. One cup. One pause.
Sliceable. Unexpected. Meant to be shared.

rules: Headings (Bodoni Moda) must never be bold; use font-light or font-normal for extreme editorial elegance.
Never center-align large blocks of text. Favor left alignment for readability and asymmetric tension.
Use wide tracking on uppercase overlines for a luxurious, architectural feel.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The Bento/Editorial Hybrid (Mode A: Tetris) - Asymmetry, visual tension, breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: py-24 or py-32 for sections, gap-12 or gap-16 between structural grid elements.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Exposed grid lines or delicate 1px borders (border-[#DFD7CA]) to section off content, giving an editorial/magazine layout feel.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm). Dark cocoa background with parchment text, or outline button with 1px cocoa border. MUST have data-testid.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless design preferred. Use pure HTML/Tailwind to create overlapping image-text compositions. No generic drop shadows. If shadows are needed, use very diffuse, ambient shading.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Input/Form elements but strip away the 'SaaS' look. Replace rounded borders with sharp bottom-borders only (border-b) for an editorial 'fill-in-the-blank' feel, or very subtle 1px complete borders.
components_strategy.navigation: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F6F0]/80). Delicate bottom border. Links must be text-sm uppercase with wide tracking.
components_strategy.motion: Use Lenis for momentum scrolling. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fade-ups and slow image scaling on hover. Images should have a subtle parallax effect.

sections: Hero: Asymmetric layout. 'Born in Sicily. Served in slices.' oversized Bodoni Moda text. Image: split-img1.jpg. Parallax background or slow pan.
The Illusion (Explainer): Side-by-side text and product_board.jpg. Explaining it's 100% chocolate, no meat. Playful but elegant.
Collection/Products Teaser: 2-3 items in a loose grid. 'Inquire to Order' CTAs.
Serving Ritual: 3-column masonry or staggered layout. Espresso pairing, slicing instructions.
Accolades/Press: Marquee or elegant list featuring SF Made badge and quotes.
Newsletter: Editorial block with terracotta/ember background accent.

Collection.layout: Editorial gallery. Not a standard e-commerce grid. Alternate image sizes (col-span-1 vs col-span-2). Generous negative space.

Product_Detail.layout: Two-column sticky layout. Left side: Scrollable large macro images. Right side: Sticky product info, ingredients, 'Inquire' button, accordion for serving/slicing notes.

Our_Story.layout: Magazine feature style. Large typography quotes. Interlocking images (founder_eva, sicily_landscape, italian_moment). Focus on Grandma Margherita and the SF transition.

Journal.layout: Staggered list of articles with prominent dates and overlines. Images: journal_1, nostalgia, split_blog.

Contact.layout: Minimalist, high-end inquiry form. Left: Contact details & wholesale info. Right: Clean, border-bottom only form fields.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an ARTISAN ITALIAN FOOD brand, not fashion. The vibe is Aesop or Tartine Bakery. Emphasize tactile warmth.
CRITICAL: Do not use generic SaaS layouts. Build custom HTML/Tailwind sections using the tetris/bento grid philosophy. Use asymmetry.
CRITICAL: Use ONLY the provided image_urls. Do not use placeholders. If you need an image for a section, pull from the list provided.
Typography: Use Bodoni Moda for headings and Manrope for body text. Ensure Bodoni Moda is imported via Google Fonts in the CSS/HTML.
Colors: Strictly adhere to the Parchment/Cocoa palette. NO purples, teals, or generic gradients.
Functionality: Showcase only. Replace 'Add to Cart' with 'Inquire to Order' or 'Contact Us'.
Testing: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form fields) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-inquire-button').
